messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#define ok(a) printf("ok ___%d___\n", a)
#define DEBUG(...) fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__)
template <class T> inline bool Chkmin(T &x, T y) { return x > y ? x = y, true : false; }
template <class T> inline bool Chkmax(T &x, T y) { return x < y ? x = y, true : false; }
template <class T> inline T read(T &x) {
	static int f;
	static char c;
	for (f = 1; !isdigit(c = getchar()); ) if (c == '-') f = -f;
	for (x = 0; isdigit(c); c = getchar()) x = x * 10 + c - 48;
	return x *= f;
}
template <class T> inline void write(T x, char P = 0) {
	static char s[20];
	static int top = 0;
	if (x < 0) x = -x, putchar('-');
	do {s[++top] = x % 10 + 48;} while (x /= 10);
	do {putchar(s[top]);} while (--top);
	if (P) putchar(P);
}
inline void open() {
	freopen(".in", "r", stdin);
	freopen(".out", "w", stdout);
}
int $, _;
const int MO = 1e9 + 7;
const int oo = 0x3f3f3f3f;
const int MAXN = 1e5 + 5;
const int MAXM = 1e6 + 5;

int K, P;
bool vis[MAXM];

inline int qpow(int x, int n) {
	int ans = 1;
	while (n) {
		if (n & 1) ans = (LL) ans * x % MO;
		x = (LL) x * x % MO;
		n >>= 1;
	}
	return ans;
}

int main() {
	read(P), read(K);
	if (K == 0) {
		write(qpow(P, P - 1));
		return 0;
	}
	if (K == 1) {
		write(qpow(P, P));
		return 0;
	}
	int p = 1;
	int cnt = 0;
	while (!vis[p]) {
		cnt++;
		vis[p] = 1;
		p = (LL) K * p % P;
	}
	write(qpow(P, P / cnt));
	return 0;
}
